question: Can an explicitly bounded incremental predictor trained only on actual selected public before/action/returned-after observations learn and persist distinct action-conditioned effects on the COMPLETE original seven-action MG19 public schema, reject zero-effect and contradictory distractors, and forecast short compositional consequences without converting to R7's 8-bit/three-action grammar?

custody.note: Only the preexisting exact source-authored R18/MG19 admission functions plus unchanged R10 public validation are used. This is NOT full native MG19 adaptation or original MiniGrid execution.

legal_input.observation: entire 7x7x3 source-public image, original orientation 0..3 and exact source-admitted public mission; no omission or one-byte compression
legal_input.action: original selected action IDs 0..6 with exact source ordering
legal_input.update: only selected before/action/returned-after, followed by legitimate returned reward/termination if needed for accounting; no counterfactual outcome
legal_input.withheld: private world state, position/map oracle, privileged mission/category labels, task solution, hidden graph, reset seed, environment/source filename, teacher state, future returns, unchosen action results

mechanism.new_source_only_layer: online, bounded, selected-effect predictor with distinct no-change posterior and supported changed-public-component posterior; explicitly mark uncertain predictions as ABSTAIN rather than copying before state as known next state
mechanism.conditional_features: public source-observable local image/component context, direction and mission observations only; any architecture-specific features must be prospectively enumerated before synthetic fixture execution
mechanism.transition: retain full public before/after and selected identity; maintain observed effect/no-effect evidence; deny credit to unselected or outcome-independent distractors
mechanism.prediction: report per-action support and abstain for unseen/contradictory transitions; finite horizon 1..5 using only own predicted public states; never claim source-independent transfer
mechanism.memory: bounded selected events, event provenance, stable serialized state, external trusted SHA and exact restoration in a fresh OS process; reject incomplete selected action, corrupt checkpoint, schema/blob mismatch
no_go_shortcuts: world ID/task ID as predictor feature

prospective_source_only_design.fixtures: self-authored public-valid seven-action before/after pairs passed through the pinned original mission/public admission contract, explicitly artificial; no Farama/MiniGrid engine or original source reset/step
prospective_source_only_design.cohorts: fixed ordered synthetic FIT and synthetic CHECK-only cohorts must be declared in code before first fixture call; CHECK not available to candidate updater or hyperparameter selection
prospective_source_only_design.budgets: cap 128 actual selected feedback pairs per action per synthetic regime, 5-action compositions, 4 predetermined development seeds, 3 source-admitted mission variants; count all attempted actions, support violations and abstentions
prospective_source_only_design.matched_controls: fit a source-visible Bayesian/count conditional predictor, an equally trained recurrent/state-space learner where feasible, a source-visible model-based conditional predictor, unchanged/identity predictor, and no-history/effect-shuffled ablations with identical chosen action, observation and fit budget
tests: exact original full image/mission/direction and distinct action ID identity on every observation
reject privileged fields and invalid source mission/action without state mutation
learn true observed no-op vs actual public change and avoid false delayed association to unrelated actions
unseen or contradictory after-effects trigger calibrated uncertainty or abstention
cold-process external-SHA checkpoint and replay equivalence
same-information source-only controls fitted rather than handicapped; explicitly report ties and negatives
match synthetic FIT/CHECK rights and no test/feature/seed adjustments after CHECK scores
measure per-arm wall/CPU, peak RSS if available, retained state/checkpoint bytes, fit/predict counts and failed attempts
Linux and Windows tests plus mandatory complete FORGE general regression on exact immutable head
prospective_source_only_design.pass_boundary: SOURCE_ONLY_INTERFACE_PASS requires all invariant/custody/anti-leakage/abstention controls and full integration CI; predictive advantage is NOT implied even when fixture results improve
prospective_source_only_design.scientific_decision: NO SCIENTIFIC GO from any source-only fixture. If strongest fully trained same-input control matches or wins, record NEGATIVE. Original-world heldout causal improvement, truly novel family transfer, FSA first-use, independent admission and objective qualification require separate authorized prospective gate.

noninterference: Additive prereg only in existing draft #1267; no protected main, original Farama source step, native Wingless/Yggdrasil source mutation, controller/runner/queue change, private CKB-plane access, release, scientific cohort consumption, first-use, acceptance or promotion.
